notes: Correctly produced 駅はどこですか and この電車は速いですか during placement; retrieved both question formation and 駅はどこですか correctly again in Lesson 001. In Lesson 003, question formation was retrieved repeatedly; an initial nearby-existence question omitted か, but later 何時 questions were produced correctly.

meaning: polite negative for noun and な-adjective predicates
notes: Pattern remained correct in Lesson 001, but 静か was not retrieved; vocabulary rather than grammar was the problem. In Lesson 002, 静か was retrieved but the learner first used 静かません, then corrected to 静かじゃないです after feedback; review again soon. In Lesson 003, 静かじゃないです was produced correctly without the earlier verb-negative error; は was recommended over が for the neutral hotel statement.

Explained in Lesson 001 and used correctly in familiar question patterns. Continue mixed production rather than isolated drills. In Lesson 003, used correctly in schedule questions/statements such as 電車は何時ですか and レストランは七時から十時までです.

Initially confused with で in コンビニを水で買います in Lesson 001, then stabilised. In Lesson 002, 水を was retrieved correctly in both past shopping production and the final に/で contrast. Extracurricular preview on 2026-08-26: place + を with 出ます can mark the place being left, e.g. 日本を出ます. Do not treat that additional use as integrated curriculum yet.

Used destination に correctly in Lesson 001. In Lesson 002, existence-location に was learned and mostly produced correctly; one guided action sentence incorrectly used コンビニに水を買います before the に/で contrast was corrected and later mastered. Lesson 003 due review exposed one repeated に/で error in 昨日、ホテルに食べました; corrected to で. Lesson 004 extended specific-time に to calendar dates and destination に remained mostly usable, but mixed existence/action prompts again produced ホテルで何人いますか and 店に二つ買います. Keep short review.

meaning: place of action or means marker
notes: Initially confused with を in コンビニを水で買います in Lesson 001, then used correctly. In Lesson 002, one guided action-location item used に instead of で, followed by correct ホテルで食べます and コンビニで水を買います in uncued production. In Lesson 003, initially used に for the location of eating, then later produced 昨日、ホテルで食べませんでした correctly. Lesson 004 opened with correct ホテルで食べました, but mixed counter/date production later used 店に instead of 店で for buying. Keep short review.
Understood as present/future depending on context. Retrieved correctly again in Lesson 002 with ホテルで食べます.
Initially used 買います with 昨日 once in Lesson 001, then corrected. Retrieved correctly in Lesson 002 as 昨日、コンビニで水を買いました.
Produced 行きません correctly in Lesson 001 and again in Lesson 002 in 明日、電車で京都に行きません.

Introduced during Lesson 001 after the learner was unfairly prompted for an untaught form. Subsequently produced 買いませんでした, 食べませんでした, and 行きませんでした correctly; not directly retrieved in Lesson 002. Retrieved correctly in Lesson 003 with 昨日、京都に行きませんでした and the final mastery item 昨日、ホテルで食べませんでした.

Introduced in Lesson 002. Correctly distinguished from います and produced in several practical location sentences. Lesson 003 opened with 近くにコンビニがります (missing あ and か), then corrected. Lesson 004 due review produced 近くにコンビニがありますか correctly without support; space slightly.

Introduced in Lesson 002 and previously retrieved correctly for people/animals. Lesson 004 successfully used います with 二人/三人 and 何人 in several production items, but one comprehension item was mistranslated as 行きます and mixed location prompts still exposed に/で instability. Keep short review.

meaning: marks the specific time when an action occurs
notes: Introduced in Lesson 003 for clock times. Lesson 004 extended the same pattern to calendar dates: 十一月二十日に京都に行きます and similar date + action sentences were produced reliably. Learner also learned that noun-predicate dates use Xは日付です rather than adding に before です.
Introduced for practical schedules in Lesson 003. 三時から七時まで and レストランは七時から十時までです were produced correctly; one 店は九時から五時まで omitted final です but the range markers themselves were correct.

meaning: calendar dates and asking the date
notes: Introduced formally in Lesson 004. Month readings 三月・七月・十一月 were retrieved correctly. Date readings initially caused errors: 十六日 was misread and 二十日 incorrectly took にち twice before correction; 三十日 became reliable. 予約は何月何日ですか was taught, and the contrast 予約は十一月二十日です versus 十一月二十日に行きます required one correction.

meaning: people counter; 一人 and 二人 are irregular
notes: Introduced in Lesson 004. 一人=ひとり, 二人=ふたり, 三人=さんにん and 何人=なんにん were recalled correctly. The learner produced ホテルに友達が三人います and ホテルに友達が何人いますか correctly. In harder mixed sentences, counter placement and an unnecessary が after 三人 caused some instability.

Introduced in Lesson 004. 一つ=ひとつ, 二つ=ふたつ, 三つ=みっつ were recalled correctly and 水を二つください was produced correctly. In a later mixed sentence, the counter was correct but 店に was used instead of action-location 店で.

Introduced in an ad hoc question about tentatively going to Himeji: 11月16日は姫路に行くかもしれません. Record only as extracurricular; do not schedule for normal N5 review or use it to advance the plan until explicitly integrated.
